name: CategoryMultisortNeue
author: Lakeus
description: Allows readers to view one category page under several different collations (for example pinyin, zhuyin and stroke for Chinese) while the wiki keeps a single $wgCategoryCollation.

CategoryMultisortNeueModes.description: Map of sort mode id to the collation name used for that mode. The id is what appears in the cmsmode URL parameter and in the categorymultisortneue-mode-<id> message key. An empty collation name means 'use $wgCategoryCollation'.

CategoryMultisortNeueDefaultMode.description: Sort mode id selected when the reader has not chosen one and has no user preference.

CategoryMultisortNeueShowSelector.description: Whether to show the sort mode selector on category pages.

CategoryMultisortNeueWriteOnEdit.description: Whether edits should maintain categorylinks_multisort incrementally. When false, only the maintenance scripts write the table.

CategoryMultisortNeuePreference.description: Whether the per-user 'preferred sort mode' preference is offered.

CategoryMultisortNeueInlineFallback.description: Whether to also render the sort mode control in the page body, as a list of links, for skins that do not render sidebar portlets (Minerva). When JavaScript runs, the fallback is removed if the skin already rendered the portlet, so no reader sees the control twice.

CategoryMultisortNeueFoldVariants.description: Whether to fold writing-system variants to one canonical variant before building a sort key, so that variant pairs such as 体 and 體 are ordered together instead of by their differing shapes. Only has an effect on a wiki whose language has variants. Changing this requires rebuilding the sort keys.

CategoryMultisortNeueCanonicalVariant.description: Language variant that sort keys are folded to, for example 'zh-hans' or 'zh-hant'. Empty means: use the site's own variant when it is a concrete one, otherwise zh-hans. Only used when $wgCategoryMultisortNeueFoldVariants is enabled.
